# Uttom Akash

> Senior Software Engineer specializing in high-performance storage engines, distributed systems, and cloud-native architectures. 5+ years of experience working across Rust, Go, C++, and the JVM ecosystem on storage engines, databases, distributed transactions, microservices, WASM, and PDF tooling.

Site: https://meshcort.com

## Profile
- Role: Senior Software Engineer (currently at Iron Software, Thailand)
- Education: B.Sc. in Software Engineering, Shahjalal University of Science and Technology (SUST), CGPA 3.72/4.00, 4th in department
- Expertise: Storage & Databases, Distributed and Embedded Systems, Cloud & Microservices, Generative AI & RAG, Full-stack Development, DevOps, Blockchain
- Languages: C++, Rust, Go, C#, Java, Python, JavaScript
